Team, great work pushing forward with Claude Code today! Our aggregate performance score landed at a solid 47.5, reflecting strong, collaborative momentum across our active branches. Keep up the fantastic pace as we tackle our current sprint backlog.

Thank you all for your dedication and innovation!
